info.text:
Mortgage rates finally fell. Here's why it barely helps.
Freddie Mac: the average 30-year fixed rate was 7.32% on Oct 22, 2026, down from 7.40%, the first weekly drop since August.
A year ago it was 6.19%.
Example: on a $400,000 loan, principal and interest is about $2,748 a month at 7.32% vs. $2,447 at 6.19%, about $300 more.
The latest dip saves that borrower about $22 a month.
Sources: Freddie Mac Primary Mortgage Market Survey (Oct 22, 2026).
News and education, not financial advice.
